scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev -w @simply-clean/api" "npm run dev -w @simply-clean/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @simply-clean/test-support && npm run build -w @simply-clean/contracts && npm run build -w @simply-clean/config && npm run build -w @simply-clean/database
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- npm run migrate -w @simply-clean/database
scripts.auth:provision: npm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- npm run auth:provision -w @simply-clean/api
scripts.catalog:import: npm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- npm run catalog:import -w @simply-clean/api
scripts.catalog:coverage: npm run build:packages && npm run catalog:coverage -w @simply-clean/api
scripts.catalog:backfill: npm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- npm run catalog:backfill -w @simply-clean/api --
scripts.evaluate:ocr-verifiers: npm run build:packages && dotenv -e .env -- tsx apps/api/src/ocr-verifier-evaluate.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:browser: API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3101 npm run build && playwright test
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @simply-clean/api && npm run build -w @simply-clean/web
